description:
AstroCultureX — From Space to Soil

We are passionate about space technology, web development, AI, and sustainable agriculture. Our NASA Space Apps 2026 project, FieldShift, explores how NASA data can help farmers improve crop rotation, soil health, water use, and climate resilience.

We welcome developers, designers, data enthusiasts, and agriculture lovers, including beginners. Join us to turn space science into practical solutions for farmers!
